title: Forgotten Battlefield - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Forgotten Battlefield in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: A battlefield strewn with the remains of earlier expeditions. It hosts Dualliste, the first boss after Verso joins, and a number of merchant finds.

sections.title: How to Reach Forgotten Battlefield
sections.content: Reached during Act 2 as part of the Monolith route.

sections.title: Bosses Here
sections.content: Dualliste, Luster, Ramasson, Greatsword Cultist, Chromatic Troubadour

sections.title: Collectibles & Notable Loot
sections.content: Dualiso, Benisim, Lusteson, Ramasson, Energising Attack I
